summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AIScholar's new feature batch (word-count bug fix, long-wait UX, citation style, mandatory academic components, suggested references via CrossRef, free public AI checker, rewrite-coach 200k cap). All 9 pytest cases pass and all UI verifications pass.

minor.issue: Per-IP daily rate limit uses in-memory dict; behind multiple uvicorn workers each has its own counter, so the '5 per IP per day' limit is enforced per-worker rather than globally. 429 still fires, but the effective ceiling can be up to 5 x workers. Consider moving counter to Mongo/Redis.

ui_bugs.issue: Small helper below the Target Word Count input still says 'Minimum 280 words (1 page)' even though the input now accepts values as low as 1. Confusing copy after the bug-fix.

Citation Style selector renders with default APA; citation-select data-testid present

POST /api/assignments citation_style defaults to 'apa' when omitted
Draft generation for 300-word assignment includes Cover/Course, Table of Contents, References, Appendix
GET /api/assignments/{id}/suggested-references returns non-empty references with title/authors/year/doi/url
GET /api/assignments/{bad-id}/suggested-references returns 404
POST /api/free-ai-check (no auth) returns ai_likelihood, issues, remaining_today
POST /api/free-ai-check with >4000 chars returns 400 'Free tier limit'
POST /api/free-ai-check with empty text returns 400
POST /api/free-ai-check 6th call from same IP returns 429 within same worker
POST /api/rewrite-coach/analyze accepts 30k-char input (no 400) and returns 200
AssignmentDetail long-wait UX: 5000-word assignment shows 'Long assignment (~5,000 words) — this can take 2–4 minutes'
AssignmentDetail short-wait UX: 500-word assignment shows 'This usually takes 20–60 seconds'
generating-card data-testid renders correctly for both cases
Public References (refs-card + load-refs-btn) renders real CrossRef results (DOI/title/authors/year/venue)
/ai-checker reachable without login; check-textarea, run-check-btn, char-counter, result-card, score present
AI checker button disables when text > 4000 chars; character counter shows over-limit (e.g. '4,500 / 4,000')
Landing page nav-ai-checker and hero-ai-checker-cta both present and navigate to /ai-checker
Regression: user register + auto-login + dashboard listing works
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is 1744 lines — recommend splitting into routers/services (auth, assignments, payments, rewrite_coach, free_check, references).
In-memory _free_check_counter dict for rate limiting is not process-safe or restart-safe; per-worker leakage means the daily cap is not enforced strictly.
NewAssignment helper text ('Minimum 280 words (1 page)') is now inaccurate; either update copy or reintroduce a soft warning without blocking submission.
CrossRef error path returns 200 with {references: [], error: ...} — good; but consider caching common queries to reduce external latency.
suggested-references passes user's raw title+requirements into external API; consider basic sanitisation/length caps (already ~300 char cap, ok).
Free AI check endpoint returns 500 on LLM exception — acceptable but log volume could be noisy on transient LLM outages.
action_items: (LOW) Update or remove 'Minimum 280 words (1 page)' helper copy on NewAssignment to reflect new min=1 behaviour.
(LOW) Consider persisting the free-ai-check rate limit in Mongo/Redis so the 5/day/IP cap works across uvicorn workers.
(INFO) Consider splitting server.py into smaller router modules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI checks pass, only 1 low-priority copy nit)
